title: T&N did not help me with return
text: T&N did not help me with return. They just emailed me and told me to call a church.  I live by myself in a rural area and am stuck with this heavy lump of foam to dispose of.  It is too heavy for me to move and awkward to make.  I did not find it to be any more or less comfortable than my spring mattress.  I would say I am more disappointed by their customer service than the mattress.

product_metadata.title: Tuft & Needle Mint Classic Cal King Mattress - Extra Cooling Adaptive Foam with Ceramic Gel Beads and Edge Support - Supportive Pressure Relief - CertiPUR-US - 100 Night Trial
features: Progressive support - When pressure is applied to gel beads, they stack to create a unique cushioned feel that adds a more progressive, supportive feel. Additionally, we added 4 inches of extra-firm foam around the bottom foam layer for extra edge support so you feel secure all night long

Extra breathability - We added 30% more graphite to the top layer of our open-cell T&N Adaptive foam to help draw heat away from your body as you sleep. In addition, our cover is designed to feel cozy and breathable

Luxurious comfort - With two comfort layers of our proprietary T&N Adaptive foam and a super luxe knit cover, the Mint is indulgently comfy and cozy. We designed this mattress to provide pressure relief to spots like hips and shoulders

Certified - We go the extra mile to get our mattresses Greenguard Gold and Certi PUR certified; This means our beds are held to the highest of standards and are third party certified to be free of harmful chemicals, substances or materials

No Risk - Our mattress has an honest 10 year limited warranty you can actually use (no gimmicks) and 100-Night Sleep Trial. Please allow up to 72 hours for the mattress to full expand, if you have any questions at all, do not hesitate to reach out!

details.Product Care Instructions: Spot clean only. Cover not made to be removed. Do not remove cover
